title: Chapter 9: Serverless Edge Deployments on Cloudflare Pages

blocks.text: Deploying modern frontend applications requires more than dumping static HTML on an Apache virtual host. In modern software engineering, web applications are deployed to **Edge Networks**—globally distributed Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) that execute computation and serve assets within single-digit milliseconds of the end user. This chapter explores modern frontend build tooling, edge caching mechanics, and automated CI/CD deployments using **Cloudflare Pages**.
Edge Computing, CDNs, and Edge Caching

Traditional web hosting relies on a centralized origin server (e.g., a server in Northern Virginia, `us-east-1`). A user accessing that application from Indore or Mumbai, India, experiences significant latency due to physical packet transit across undersea fiber cables ($>180$ milliseconds round-trip).

blocks.text: Anycast DNS and Edge Points of Presence (PoPs)
Cloudflare operates across more than 330 cities worldwide. When a user queries a domain managed by Cloudflare:

blocks.title: Key Highlights
lines: • **BGP Anycast Routing**: The Domain Name System (DNS) resolves the domain to an identical IP address announced by all 330+ data centers simultaneously. The Internet routing protocol (BGP) directs the user's TCP packets to the physically nearest Point of Presence (PoP).

• **Edge Caching**: When static JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and images are requested, the edge server returns the cached asset directly from ultra-fast NVMe/RAM storage without contacting the origin server.

blocks.text: Modern Frontend Tooling: The Vite Build Pipeline
Modern frontend engineering relies on **Vite**, an ultra-fast build tool powered by native browser ES modules and the C-based **esbuild** bundler.

blocks.code:
# Scaffold modern frontend project with Vite
npm create vite@latest ai-dashboard -- --template vanilla-ts

cd ai-dashboard
npm install

# Run hot-module replacement (HMR) local development server
npm run dev

# Compile and minify for production deployment
npm run build
blocks.caption: Scaffolding and Building a Modern Frontend Application

blocks.text: The `npm run build` command performs code-splitting, tree-shaking (removing unused library functions), and generates content-hashed assets inside the `dist/` directory (e.g., `assets/index-a9f3b2.js`). These immutable hashes allow edge servers to cache assets indefinitely.
Cloudflare Pages provides automated Git-integrated CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment).

blocks.title: Key Highlights
lines: • In the Cloudflare Dashboard, connect your GitHub account and select the repository.

blocks.text: Direct CLI Deployment via Cloudflare Wrangler
You can also deploy local build artifacts directly from the terminal without Git using the **Wrangler CLI**:

blocks.code:
# Authenticate Wrangler with Cloudflare account
npx wrangler login

# Deploy the production dist folder directly to the edge
npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=ai-vision-dashboard
blocks.caption: Deploying to Cloudflare Pages via Wrangler CLI

blocks.text:
**The Physics of Edge Latency:**
Signals in optical fiber propagate at approximately $200,000\text{ km/s}$ ($\approx 2/3$ the speed of light in vacuum). A transatlantic data round-trip between India and North America physically cannot occur in less than $120\text{ ms}$, even ignoring routing router hops and switch contention! By caching frontend assets at edge PoPs in India, you eliminate this physical speed-of-light barrier, providing sub-20ms instant application load times.

**Question**: *“Why deploy to Cloudflare Pages instead of hosting our frontend directly on our backend server with `express.static` or FastAPI?”*
**Defense**: *“Separation of concerns. Serving static frontend assets from a Python or Node backend ties up backend compute threads with static file I/O. Cloudflare Pages offloads static asset delivery to over 330 global edge data centers with free DDoS mitigation, HTTP/3 support, Brotli compression, and automatic edge caching. This leaves our backend compute instances 100% free to execute Python machine learning inference and database transactions.”*
